title: Food Microbiology RBP Prioritization and Magnetic Bioseparation Workflow
description: Auditable frozen G_pre1 prioritization across 827 candidates, 10,000 weight perturbations, component and masking audits, and deterministic C_verified/G_pro1 feedback. G_pro1 is deterministic feedback, not machine-learning retraining. All 18 tests pass and 51 reproducibility-output hashes match. Source monorepo commit: 67a434bfd2e8a967d42dd9d67ef7025b33714708.
